title: EBS 라디오 입이 트이는 영어 - 7.14 A 'Miraculous Wedding'
vocab:
ever since: 그 이래 줄곧
at one point: 한 때
favor: 호의
favor to ask: 부탁하다
come up to: 다가오다
gladly: 기꺼이
miraculous: 기적적인
sentences:
He seemed like the kind of person who you could trust.
He carefully came up to me and said he had a favor to ask.
His marriage really felt like a miracle to me.
